id_policy.rule: Mechanism blocks describe verified semantic handoffs across canonical GSI systems; they never create systems or certify parity.

MBLK-001-SELL-MISSION-AUTHORITY.name: Sell mission authority and reverse buildup
MBLK-001-SELL-MISSION-AUTHORITY.contract: An accepted building sell enters a durable three-state mission. Reverse buildup and animation completion, not command receipt, gate final sell completion while the building remains live.

activation.trigger: The local player issues an accepted sell action for a live owned building.
activation.stock_fixture: Sell a stock GAPOWR in an ordinary skirmish after it has completed construction.
guards: The selected object is a live owned building.
Sell acceptance and eligibility gates are not yet exhaustively mapped in this pilot.

inputs.name: accepted sell action
inputs.detail: The admitted player action assigns the selling mission.

inputs.name: mission substate and animation completion
inputs.detail: The selling mission owns its substate and observes the completion byte.

inputs.name: reverse buildup timing
inputs.detail: Building presentation state seeds reverse buildup and advances the completion gate.

authority.detail: Admits the player sell action.
Owns the three-state selling mission and completion observation.
Owns live, uninitialization, and removal lifecycle; the sell mission relies on the building remaining live until completion is authorized.
Orders start, occupant or crew consequences, reverse buildup, wait, and completion.
Owns reverse buildup animation timing.

steps.action: Issue and admit the sell action.
Selling state 0 clears completion, broadcasts start, clears conflicting animation, and advances.
Selling state 1 applies crew or occupant consequences when applicable, broadcasts or plays the sell cue, and advances.
GrandOpening(0) seeds reverse buildup and clears animation completion.
Selling state 2 waits for animation completion before emitting final sell completion.

outputs.name: sell completion gate
outputs.detail: The selling mission may enter the refund and teardown transaction only after reverse buildup completes.

outputs.name: live reverse-buildup selling state
outputs.detail: The player sees the building reverse its buildup while it remains part of the live world.

critical_semantics.detail: Sell command receipt does not immediately destroy, remove, or refund the building.
Reverse buildup timing is driven by type and asset data; the stock GAPOWR fixture uses its make animation rather than a fixed universal delay.
The exact scheduler pass in which the completion byte becomes visible to Mission_Selling remains unverified.
The pilot has not exhaustively proven whether all sell-start side effects consume no gameplay RNG.

MBLK-001-SELL-MISSION-AUTHORITY.research_query: BuildingClass Mission_Selling sell reverse buildup GrandOpening UpdateAnimation completion byte power plant

open_questions.detail: Does animation completion become observable in the same scheduler pass or the next pass?
Abort, cancel, destruction-during-sell, and survivor-placement failure paths are not closed.
Save/load persistence of selling mission and reverse-animation state is not mapped.

MBLK-002-SELL-REFUND-COMMIT.name: Sell completion refund and teardown transaction
MBLK-002-SELL-REFUND-COMMIT.contract: Only after sell mission completion, dirty affected derived state, compute the rules-driven refund, credit the owner, apply applicable completion consequences, then uninitialize the building. Damage alone does not health-scale the refund.

activation.trigger: Selling mission state 2 observes its animation-completion gate.
activation.stock_fixture: Complete the stock GAPOWR sell begun by MBLK-001.
guards: The sell mission completion byte is set.
The selling building and owner remain valid for the completion transaction.

inputs.name: sell completion
inputs.detail: The durable sell mission authorizes the completion transaction.

inputs.name: refund configuration
inputs.detail: Type cost, owner cost modifiers, and General RefundPercent determine the amount.
inputs.external_source: Retail TechnoType cost and merged rules RefundPercent

authority.detail: Computes and orders sell-completion consequences.
Orders derived-state dirtiness, refund, special completion effects, and UnInit.
Owns the credited money delta.
Owns final uninitialization and world removal.

steps.action: Dirty the owner's affected derived state.
Compute refund through the type virtual and configured multiplier.
Credit the owner; stock full-health GAPOWR yields 400 under stock rules.
Apply special sell-completion consequences such as ore-purifier bookkeeping when applicable.
Uninitialize and remove the completed selling building.

outputs.name: credited refund
outputs.detail: The owner's money state and visible credit display receive the rules-derived refund.

outputs.name: building teardown
outputs.detail: The lifecycle owner removes the completed selling building from the world.

outputs.name: dirty power and radar state
outputs.detail: Removing a power producer makes house power and downstream radar consequences eligible for reassessment.

critical_semantics.detail: Refund and teardown are completion effects, not command-edge effects.
RefundPercent is rules-driven and the stock full-health GAPOWR fixture credits 400.
The native sell-refund path does not scale refund by current building health merely because the building is damaged.
The pilot has not exhaustively proven RNG use in every special sell-completion consequence.

MBLK-002-SELL-REFUND-COMMIT.research_query: building sell completion refund RefundPercent owner cost bonus UnInit

open_questions.detail: The owner-bonus and x87 conversion input space is not exhaustively covered.
Ore-purifier sell-completion consequences are outside the selected fixture.

MBLK-003-HOUSE-POWER-REASSESSMENT.name: House power reassessment and low-power transition
MBLK-003-HOUSE-POWER-REASSESSMENT.contract: When house power is dirty, recompute output and drain from live owned buildings that are not being destroyed. Presentation-only buildup or selling state does not revoke power authority; publish the low-power transition before radar and local consumer handoffs.

activation.trigger: House update observes dirty power after sell UnInit or replacement Unlimbo.
activation.stock_fixture: Sell the fixture's only positive-margin stock GAPOWR, then place a replacement; blackout is excluded.
guards: The building belongs to the house and remains live in the authoritative collection.
Buildings being destroyed do not contribute.
The selected fixture does not activate the separate blackout path.

inputs.name: dirty lifecycle state
inputs.detail: Building removal, creation, reveal, or activation makes the derived power state eligible for reassessment.

inputs.name: non-authoritative presentation state
inputs.detail: Selling mission and buildup presentation may coexist with live power contribution; neither presentation state owns entity lifecycle or power eligibility.

inputs.name: prior house power state
inputs.detail: The house owns the old totals, dirty flag, blackout state, and notification guard.

inputs.name: building power data
inputs.detail: Power, health, reactor, and occupant state feed the aggregate.
inputs.external_source: Retail building rules and live entity state

authority.detail: Owns output, drain, low-power predicate, dirty state, and transition guard.
Owns aggregate contribution and low-power calculation.
Owns whether a building is live, uninitialized, or removed; house power reads that lifecycle state when deciding contribution eligibility.
Publishes power before radar and notification handoffs.

steps.action: Handle blackout state and record the prior low-power predicate.
Clear dirty state and aggregate totals.
Iterate the native house-list order and add health-scaled production, full drain, and applicable reactor or garrison contributions.
Recalculate power-sensitive factory consequences.
Publish the new transition and mark tactical radar for reassessment.

outputs.name: power totals and transition
outputs.detail: Downstream production, radar, sidebar, and EVA consumers receive the assessed house power state.

outputs.name: radar recheck
outputs.detail: Aggregate power changes cause the powered-radar gate to be reevaluated.

critical_semantics.detail: Low power is output less than drain while drain is nonzero.
A live building can retain power authority during buildup or selling presentation until authoritative removal.
House power assessment precedes the powered-radar reassessment in the selected update path.
Exact x87 versus Rust integer rounding for all production values is not proven.
Exact placement or teardown timing relative to the next House update is not proven.
The pilot has not exhaustively proven RNG neutrality for every contributing building subtype.

MBLK-003-HOUSE-POWER-REASSESSMENT.research_query: HouseClass AI_AssessPower power dirty output drain low power building buildup selling lifecycle

open_questions.detail: Exact native rounding across the power contribution input space remains unproven.
Scheduler timing of lifecycle dirtiness and same-tick downstream consequences remains open.
Native house-list order and Rust entity-order consequences have not been ruled out.
Production slowdown must be revisited after lifecycle authority is corrected.

MBLK-004-POWERED-RADAR-GATE.name: Powered tactical-radar availability gate
MBLK-004-POWERED-RADAR-GATE.contract: Local tactical-radar availability is gated by aggregate power and then the first eligible Radar=yes provider, including FreeRadar and provider EMP or warping semantics. SpySat is separate.

activation.trigger: House power assessment marks tactical radar for reassessment.
activation.stock_fixture: Use one eligible stock Radar=yes provider with Power=-50, then cross and recover the aggregate power threshold.
guards: The queried house is the local tactical house unless FreeRadar applies.
SpySat behavior is outside this tactical-radar provider gate.
The provider is live and eligible for the first-candidate check.

inputs.name: assessed aggregate power
inputs.detail: The house's output and drain gate powered radar.

inputs.name: eligible radar provider
inputs.detail: Live Radar=yes provider state supplies the provider gate.
inputs.external_source: Retail Radar, FreeRadar, EMP, warping, and local-house state

authority.detail: Owns tactical-radar availability.
Owns local-house, aggregate-power, first-provider, EMP, and warping gates.
Runs after assessed house power and before publishing radar availability.
Determines which provider entities remain live candidates.

steps.action: Apply local-house and FreeRadar handling.
Supply the aggregate output-versus-drain power gate.
Inspect the first eligible Radar=yes provider and apply EMP and warping gates.
Stop after the first eligible provider whether it succeeds or fails, then publish tactical-radar availability.

outputs.name: tactical-radar availability
outputs.detail: The radar and minimap presentation owner receives the local availability state.

critical_semantics.detail: The native path terminates after the first eligible Radar=yes provider rather than searching for any successful provider.
Local-house and aggregate-power state gate tactical radar.
SpySat visibility is a separate mechanism and must not be collapsed into this provider gate.
FreeRadar, EMP, warping, and multiple-provider combinations are not exhaustively captured by the pilot.
The pilot has not exhaustively proven RNG neutrality for every radar-provider path.

MBLK-004-POWERED-RADAR-GATE.research_query: HouseClass UpdateTacticalRadarAvailability Radar FreeRadar EMP warping first candidate power gate

open_questions.detail: FreeRadar, EMP, warping, and multiple-provider cases remain outside the pilot fixture.
The exact assessment-to-radar tick boundary remains open.

MBLK-005-LOW-POWER-NOTIFICATION-GUARD.name: Low-power notification guard and EVA handoff
MBLK-005-LOW-POWER-NOTIFICATION-GUARD.contract: After power and tactical-radar reassessment, the local house emits at most one low-power notification while the guard is set. Ordinary power recovery clears the guard but emits no generic power-restored EVA.

activation.trigger: After radar reassessment, the local house update evaluates a power deficit while the low-power notification guard is clear.
activation.stock_fixture: Observe EVA behavior while the LOOP-012 fixture loses and restores power.
guards: Only the local player's voice route is asserted.
The low-power notification guard suppresses repeated announcements.

inputs.name: assessed local power state
inputs.detail: Power totals, low-power predicate, and notification guard come from house power authority.

inputs.name: configured power-plant ownership condition
inputs.detail: The native guard also checks whether the house owns the configured power-plant type before announcing low power.
inputs.external_source: Retail rules/type registry and local house ownership state

authority.detail: Owns the power-before-radar-before-notification sequence in House update.
Owns the one-shot low-power notification guard.
Owns EVA selection, queueing, and playback.

steps.action: Complete power assessment and publish its transition.
Complete powered-radar reassessment.
Clear the low-power guard at full power, or emit one low-power event and set the guard when the deficit and configured-power-plant conditions are met.

outputs.name: low-power EVA event
outputs.detail: The local house voice route receives one guarded low-power event and no generic recovery event.

critical_semantics.detail: The native House update orders power assessment before radar reassessment and before low-power notification logic.
Low-power EVA is guarded one-shot behavior, and ordinary power recovery does not emit a generic recovery EVA.
EVA queue priority, interruption, and later reannouncement behavior remain unverified.
The pilot has not exhaustively proven audio and presentation RNG consumption.

MBLK-005-LOW-POWER-NOTIFICATION-GUARD.research_query: HouseClass Update low power EVA notification guard recovery ordering

open_questions.detail: EVA queue arbitration and reannouncement behavior remain open.
Persistence of the low-power notification guard across save/load is not mapped.

MBLK-006-POWER-BAR-PRESENTATION-HANDOFF.name: Operational and theoretical power-bar handoff
MBLK-006-POWER-BAR-PRESENTATION-HANDOFF.contract: The local power bar consumes operational house output and drain, separately derives total fill from theoretical building-type power across the live house collection, and owns cached change detection plus animation state. This block claims those producer-consumer handoffs, not exact renderer-relative timing or pixel equivalence.

activation.trigger: The per-frame power-bar owner observes changed operational output or drain, or continues an active local presentation transition.
activation.stock_fixture: Observe the power bar while the LOOP-012 fixture loses and restores power.
guards: Only the local player's sidebar presentation is asserted.
Exact frame cadence, composition, and pixels are outside this semantic pilot.

inputs.name: operational output and drain
inputs.detail: The house power owner publishes current operational output and drain.

inputs.name: theoretical infrastructure power
inputs.detail: The presentation calculation sums raw building-type output and drain across the house's live building collection to determine total filled segments.
inputs.external_source: Retail BuildingTypeClass power values and live house building membership

inputs.name: cached transition and animation state
inputs.detail: PowerClass owns cached output/drain, flash and stabilization timers, and displayed segment counts.

authority.detail: Owns the operational output and drain consumed by presentation.
Owns membership of the live building collection read by the theoretical fill calculation.
Owns retail building-type power values used by the theoretical fill calculation.
Owns total-fill calculation, power distribution, cached change detection, and presentation timers.
Owns sidebar and power-bar presentation.

steps.action: Publish operational output and drain.
Compare output and drain with locally cached values and start or continue transition timers.
Derive total fill from theoretical infrastructure power and split it using operational output and drain.
Animate and draw the power-bar segment state.

outputs.name: power-bar state
outputs.detail: The local sidebar displays the assessed power state.

critical_semantics.detail: PowerClass reads operational output and drain, independently calculates theoretical fill from building-type power, and owns cached change detection and animation state.
Exact presentation cadence, composition, and pixels remain unverified.

MBLK-006-POWER-BAR-PRESENTATION-HANDOFF.research_query: PowerClass Calc_Segments Calc_Power_Distribution AI operational output drain theoretical infrastructure power bar

open_questions.detail: Exact frame cadence, composition, and pixels remain outside this semantic pilot.

MBLK-007-RADAR-PRESENTATION-HANDOFF.name: Tactical-radar availability to minimap handoff
MBLK-007-RADAR-PRESENTATION-HANDOFF.contract: The local radar and minimap presentation consumes tactical-radar availability from the powered provider gate. This block does not collapse SpySat into radar or claim exact renderer-relative timing or pixels.

activation.trigger: The local tactical-radar availability gate publishes a loss or recovery edge.
activation.stock_fixture: Observe radar and minimap presentation while the LOOP-012 fixture loses and restores powered radar.
guards: Only local tactical-radar presentation is asserted.
Exact frame cadence, composition, and pixels are outside this semantic pilot.

inputs.name: tactical-radar availability
inputs.detail: The powered-radar gate publishes whether local tactical radar is available.

authority.detail: Owns tactical-radar availability.
Owns radar and minimap presentation.

steps.action: Publish tactical-radar availability after provider and power gates.
Consume availability for radar and minimap presentation.

outputs.name: radar and minimap state
outputs.detail: The local radar and minimap reflect tactical-radar availability.

critical_semantics.detail: Tactical-radar availability is the state authority consumed by radar presentation; SpySat is separate.
Exact radar animation cadence, composition, and pixels remain unverified.

MBLK-007-RADAR-PRESENTATION-HANDOFF.research_query: tactical radar availability minimap presentation handoff SpySat separate

open_questions.detail: Exact radar animation cadence, composition, and pixels remain outside this semantic pilot.

edges.detail: Reverse-buildup completion gates the refund and teardown transaction.
Sell completion, refund, UnInit, and dirty-state handoff precede house power reassessment.
House power assessment precedes powered tactical-radar reassessment.
Radar reassessment precedes the native low-power notification guard.
Operational house output and drain route to the independently owned sidebar power-bar consumer; theoretical fill and animation remain presentation-owned inputs.
Tactical-radar availability routes to the independently owned radar and minimap consumer.
